content.body:
By the third year of dealing with recurring BV, I started noticing the smell was getting stronger no matter what I tried.

At first, my doctor said it was just “normal bacterial imbalance”. But something about it didn't feel right to me.

After reading Stanford research, I discovered this recurring cycle has a name — Biofilm Protection — and it's affecting millions of women who can't break free from BV.

Click 'Learn More' to see what the researchers uncovered.

In the ones from last weekend, my jawline was back and my stomach was flat.

I didn't join a gym, didn't cut carbs and didn't do a single crunch

The only thing that changed was what I started swallowing with her coffee every morning for 28 days. And the reason it worked on my belly when nothing else had is the part I want every woman over 35 to hear before she buys another probiotic

Boric acid. Probiotics. Showering twice a day. And by lunch, the ammonia smell is back like you didn't do any of it.

If you're diabetic and this is your daily loop, there's a reason the usual routine doesn't hold past noon. Karla walks through it in a way I hadn't heard before, especially the part about why your friend's probiotic works for her and does almost nothing for you.

The pineapple gummy part is where it clicked for me. Watch before you buy another bottle of anything.

content.body:
By the third year of dealing with recurring BV, I started noticing the smell was getting stronger no matter what I tried.

At first, my doctor said it was just “normal bacterial imbalance”. But something about it didn't feel right to me.

After reading Stanford research, I discovered this recurring cycle has a name — Biofilm Protection — and it's affecting millions of women who can't break free from BV.

Click 'Learn More' to see what the researchers uncovered.

Flat in the morning, looking 6 months pregnant by dinner. And the maddening part is you ate clean.

Most bloating content stops at food. But there's a layer inside your gut that food choices don't reach, and it's why the bloating keeps coming back regardless of what you cut out.

Certain gut bacteria build a waxy protective coating around themselves called biofilm. Stomach acid doesn't break it down. Most probiotics can't get through it. You can do a month of clean eating and those colonies are still sitting there on day 31, completely undisturbed.

That's why even water can set off a reaction. The bacteria are that entrenched.

The images below are a little playful, but they're pointing at something real. If your stomach does this through the day, there's a specific biological reason behind it. 👇
